blocks.text: In search of a nonviolent resolution, the factions agree to place written slips before the Darbar and let the divine will decide the matter.
The procedure is described carefully so that the test appears solemn, public, and binding rather than improvised.
Written slips are the key anchor because they transform quarrel into ordeal.
